lines.text: Please send me the notes ASAP.

data.define: Short for "as soon as possible"; used to ask for something quickly.

example.text: Please send me the notes ASAP.

misuse.text: Don't write 'ASAP' to your boss rudely.

native.tip: “ASAP” = o mais rápido possível. Exemplo: “Please send me the notes ASAP.”
native.caption:
O que significa “ASAP”?
“ASAP” = o mais rápido possível.
Exemplo: “Please send me the notes ASAP.” (Por favor, envie-me as notas "ASAP".)
